brief: Whether any array entry passes a test
description: Return true if predicate returns true for any entry of the first array in values (index order). Entries whose value is undefined are included. Empty array yields false. Same single-array behavior as any_of.

parameters.description: Called for each value in the first array in values or until true is returned.
parameters.name: predicate

parameters.description: Parameters passed to predicate with the first array passed one value at a time.
parameters.name: values
